title: bzip2 compress and decompress text
summary: Compress a buffer of text with bzip2 (level 9, set explicitly) and decompress it again, returning the original text.
notes: One operation is a full bzip2 compress-then-decompress round trip of an in-memory buffer. Compressed bytes differ between implementations, so only the restored text is compared; the compressed size, reported outside timing, must also be smaller than the input for the fixtures the format can shrink.
